story_title: Barley Yield Performance: Varieties, Sites, and Temporal Trends
story_subtitle: Analyzing barley yield data across different varieties, agricultural sites, and time periods to identify top-performing cultivars and site-specific factors affecting productivity

story_pieces.narration: The 'Trebi' variety consistently outperforms others with an average yield of 37.3 units, while 'No. 475' has the lowest average yield of 29.7 units across all sites in 1931 and 1932.
story_pieces.question: Which barley variety demonstrates the highest and lowest average yields across all sites and years?
story_pieces.visualization: ranked bar chart (variety vs. average yield)

story_pieces.narration: Yield performance declined significantly from 1931 to 1932 for most varieties, with 'Manchuria' experiencing the largest drop (from 31.2 to 25.4 units) and 'Trebi' showing the smallest decline (from 37.3 to 30.7 units).
story_pieces.question: How did barley yields change between 1931 and 1932 across different varieties?
story_pieces.visualization: bar chart race (year vs. variety yield changes)

story_pieces.narration: The 'University Farm' site consistently produces the highest yields (average of 36.4 units) compared to other sites, while 'Grand Rapids' has the lowest average yield (27.4 units) across all varieties and years.
story_pieces.question: Which agricultural site has the highest and lowest average yields across all varieties and years?
story_pieces.visualization: grouped bar chart (site vs. average yield per variety)

story_pieces.narration: In 1931, 'Waseca' site produces the highest yields for most varieties, but in 1932, 'Morris' site becomes the top performer for several varieties, indicating site-specific yield variations over time.
story_pieces.question: How do yield patterns differ between sites in 1931 versus 1932?
story_pieces.visualization: heatmap (site vs. year vs. variety yield)

story_pieces.narration: Yield variability is highest in 'Grand Rapids' (standard deviation of 12.8 units) and lowest in 'University Farm' (standard deviation of 7.6 units), highlighting the importance of site-specific growing conditions.
story_pieces.question: Which sites exhibit the highest and lowest yield variability across different varieties?
